_source: Generated by scripts/build-ces-shared-seed.ts from the Evidence Archetype Catalog, the Fundamental Requirements Store and control-signal-registry.json. Do not edit by hand.

archetype.name: Assessment boundary statement
archetype.description: Formal narrative defining the assessment/enclave boundary, inclusions/exclusions, and rationale.
archetype.collection_notes: Confirm boundary aligns with contract/flowdowns and matches diagrams/inventories; verify exclusions are justified and controlled.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain current version and prior version for change history; store approvals/sign-off records.

archetype.name: Network boundary diagram
archetype.description: Diagram showing logical network segmentation, ingress/egress points, and boundary controls.
archetype.collection_notes: Diagram should match actual configs (firewall/VNet/subnet rules) and reference where CUI traverses/terminates.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain diagram and source file; retain change log / approval ticket.

archetype.name: In-scope asset inventory
archetype.description: Authoritative list of in-scope endpoints, servers, cloud services, and network components.
archetype.collection_notes: Inventory must be current and reconcilable to management tooling; sample a subset for existence and ownership.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain monthly snapshots for trending; retain inventory generation procedure.

archetype.name: Interconnection / boundary agreements
archetype.description: Documentation of interconnections and shared responsibility across connected networks/tenants.
archetype.collection_notes: Clarify where controls are inherited vs customer-responsible; ensure agreements match actual integrations.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain executed agreements and updates per audit window.

archetype.name: CUI data flow diagram
archetype.description: Diagram depicting where CUI is created, stored, processed, and transmitted across systems and users.
archetype.collection_notes: Validate against actual workflows (Teams/SharePoint/repos/email); ensure boundary endpoints are explicit.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain diagram and references used; update on material workflow changes.

archetype.name: CUI location register
archetype.description: Register of systems/locations where CUI may reside, with handling rules per location.
archetype.collection_notes: Include storage locations, access model, encryption state, sharing constraints, and owner.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain current register and change history; ensure updates are controlled.

archetype.name: CUI marking/labeling procedure and examples
archetype.description: Procedure and examples for identifying and marking CUI in primary workflows.
archetype.collection_notes: Validate that marking guidance is used consistently in primary workflows; capture exceptions handling.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain procedure versions and sample artifacts per retention.

archetype.name: MFA enforcement evidence
archetype.description: Proof that MFA is required for in-scope identities per policy and configuration.
archetype.collection_notes: Include policy definition and a verification event; document exceptions (break-glass) and controls around them.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain policy exports per change; retain sign-in log samples per audit window.

archetype.name: Legacy authentication blocked evidence
archetype.description: Proof that legacy/basic authentication is disabled or blocked for in-scope identities.
acceptable_forms: IdP policy export blocking legacy auth
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate block by configuration and a denied attempt; document any allowed legacy protocols and compensating controls.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain configuration exports and test evidence per major change.

archetype.name: Privileged role assignments report
archetype.description: List of privileged roles and accounts with justification and approvals.
archetype.collection_notes: Ensure least privilege and time-bound elevation where available; retain approval/audit trail for role grants.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain monthly snapshots and approval tickets; retain revocation records.

archetype.name: Joiner-mover-leaver (JML) procedure and samples
archetype.description: Documented account lifecycle process with sample tickets/records.
archetype.collection_notes: Verify timeliness and completeness; sample terminations to confirm access removal across systems.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain procedure and sample records per audit period.

archetype.name: Access review evidence
archetype.description: Records of periodic access reviews for CUI systems and privileged roles.
archetype.collection_notes: Must show scope, cadence, reviewers, findings, and remediation actions; sample a review cycle end-to-end.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain reviews and remediation proof for defined retention period.

archetype.name: Authentication policy and standards
archetype.description: Written standards describing password policy, MFA requirements, and session constraints.
archetype.collection_notes: Policy should align to actual configuration and include exception handling.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain superseded versions and approval history.

archetype.name: Break-glass account controls evidence
archetype.description: Evidence that emergency accounts exist with documented protections and procedures.
archetype.collection_notes: Document purpose and access constraints; verify monitoring on use and strong authentication where supported.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain procedure and monitoring evidence; retain usage logs.

archetype.name: Device management enrollment report
archetype.description: Proof that in-scope endpoints are enrolled in management and meet baseline requirements.
archetype.collection_notes: Include totals and a sampled subset; reconcile to in-scope inventory.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain monthly snapshots; retain enrollment procedure and exceptions.

archetype.name: Endpoint security baseline configuration
archetype.description: Evidence that required endpoint hardening settings are defined and applied.
acceptable_forms: Screenshot of settings in management console
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate baseline definition and application scope; test a sample device for applied settings.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain baseline version history and change approvals.

archetype.name: EDR/AV deployment and health report
archetype.description: Evidence that endpoint protection is deployed, active, and monitored.
archetype.collection_notes: Show deployment coverage and health; include alert routing and response expectations.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain monthly coverage exports; retain incident records per retention policy.

archetype.name: Patch compliance report
archetype.description: Evidence of patching cadence and compliance state for in-scope endpoints/servers.
archetype.collection_notes: Include SLA/targets and exceptions; sample devices to verify patch state.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain monthly reports and remediation tickets for audit period.

archetype.name: Disk encryption evidence
archetype.description: Proof of encryption at rest on endpoints and relevant storage.
archetype.collection_notes: Show enforcement and coverage; document exclusions and compensating controls.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain reports per audit period; retain exception approvals.

archetype.name: Removable media control enforcement
archetype.description: Evidence that removable media use is controlled per policy.
acceptable_forms: Audit log of blocked USB events
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate technical enforcement or documented controls; include exceptions handling.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain policy and event samples per retention.

archetype.name: Local admin control evidence
archetype.description: Evidence that local admin rights are restricted and controlled.
archetype.collection_notes: Show least privilege and elevation workflow; sample endpoints to confirm controls.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain reports and workflow records per retention.

archetype.name: Configuration management policy and procedure
archetype.description: Policy and procedure governing baselines, changes, approvals, and documentation.
archetype.collection_notes: Ensure change control scope includes CUI systems; verify roles and emergency change handling are defined.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain versions and approvals; retain change records per audit period.

archetype.name: Change ticket samples and approvals
archetype.description: Representative change records demonstrating review, approval, testing, and implementation.
archetype.collection_notes: Sample high-impact and routine changes; ensure evidence of approval and rollback planning exists.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain tickets and approvals per retention; retain CAB schedule/records.

archetype.name: Approved baseline standards (system hardening)
archetype.description: Documented configuration standards for systems in scope.
archetype.collection_notes: Should be specific to OS/platform and map to how baselines are applied in tooling.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain version history and approval records.

archetype.name: POA&M tracking evidence
archetype.description: Evidence of POA&M process and tracking for identified gaps.
archetype.collection_notes: Ensure POA&M items have owners, dates, and closure proof; link to risk acceptance where applicable.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain POA&M snapshots and closure artifacts per retention.

archetype.name: Audit logging policy
archetype.description: Policy specifying what events are logged, retention, review, and protection of logs.
archetype.collection_notes: Policy should specify event categories, retention duration, and review cadence; align with actual log platform configuration.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain current and prior versions; retain approvals.

archetype.name: Central log collection / SIEM ingestion proof
archetype.description: Evidence that relevant sources forward logs to a central repository/SIEM.
archetype.collection_notes: Include coverage (which sources) and health; test by generating an event and confirming ingestion.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain monthly ingestion/health reports; retain connector configuration change records.

archetype.name: Log retention configuration evidence
archetype.description: Configuration proof showing retention meets policy for required log sources.
archetype.collection_notes: Show retention duration and protection; include access controls on logs.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain configuration exports per major change.

archetype.name: Security monitoring and alerting configuration
archetype.description: Evidence of alert rules, routing, and operational monitoring procedures.
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate that alerts trigger and are handled; ensure escalation paths are documented.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain alert configuration exports and sample response tickets.

archetype.name: Time synchronization evidence
archetype.description: Evidence systems synchronize time to an authoritative source for log integrity.
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate consistent time settings for key systems; verify across representative samples.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain configuration exports and test samples per audit window.

archetype.name: Vulnerability scanning evidence
archetype.description: Reports showing vulnerability scanning performed at defined cadence and scope.
archetype.collection_notes: Include scan scope and cadence; sample remediation actions for high findings.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain scan outputs and remediation tickets per audit window.

archetype.name: Vulnerability remediation tracking
archetype.description: Evidence of tracking vulnerabilities to closure with prioritization and exceptions.
archetype.collection_notes: Show prioritization and closure evidence; include exceptions with documented risk acceptance.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain remediation records and risk acceptances per retention.

archetype.name: Secure configuration scanning evidence
archetype.description: Evidence of configuration compliance scanning for baselines/benchmarks and remediation of drift.
archetype.collection_notes: Show scan cadence and remediation for drift; sample findings to closure.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain scan outputs and remediation records.

archetype.name: Risk register and risk acceptance records
archetype.description: Risk register showing identified risks, owners, decisions, and acceptance approvals.
archetype.collection_notes: Ensure risks include scope/architecture/evidence gaps; approvals must be explicit for accepted risks.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain register snapshots and acceptance approvals per policy.

archetype.name: System Security Plan (SSP) completeness evidence
archetype.description: Evidence SSP exists, reflects current boundary, and is maintained.
archetype.collection_notes: SSP must align with inventories/diagrams and reflect control implementation and inheritance.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain SSP versions and change log per policy.

archetype.name: Incident response plan and procedures
archetype.description: Documented incident response plan with roles, communications, and escalation paths.
archetype.collection_notes: Confirm plan covers detection through recovery and aligns with tooling and responsibilities.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain current and prior versions; retain approvals.

archetype.name: Incident response tabletop exercise evidence
archetype.description: Records of tabletop exercises with lessons learned and tracked actions.
archetype.collection_notes: Must show scenario, participants, outcomes, and remediation items with closure proof.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain exercise artifacts and action closure proof.

archetype.name: Incident ticket samples
archetype.description: Redacted incident records showing handling per policy.
archetype.collection_notes: Show timestamps, triage, actions, communications, and closure; demonstrate consistent procedure.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain incident records per policy and contractual requirements.

archetype.name: Encryption in transit evidence
archetype.description: Proof that data in transit is protected using approved mechanisms.
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate enforced secure channels for key services; verify protocol versions/ciphers where feasible.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain configuration exports and test evidence per audit period.

archetype.name: Media sanitization procedure and records
archetype.description: Procedure and records for sanitizing media prior to disposal or reuse.
archetype.collection_notes: Procedure must specify methods and verification; sample records for completed events.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain records per policy and contractual requirements.

archetype.name: Backup policy and restore test evidence
archetype.description: Backup policy and evidence of restore tests for critical systems.
archetype.collection_notes: Show backups run successfully and restore tests executed periodically; include RPO/RTO targets.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain job status exports and restore test reports per retention.

archetype.name: Third-party access inventory
archetype.description: Inventory of vendors/MSPs/subcontractors with access, including method and scope.
archetype.collection_notes: Include purpose, approval, expiration, and monitoring; verify least privilege and offboarding controls.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain register snapshots and approvals per audit window.

archetype.name: Supplier agreements and flowdown evidence
archetype.description: Contract clauses/agreement evidence that required security obligations are flowed down.
archetype.collection_notes: Show obligations match CUI handling requirements and include reporting/incident clauses where required.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain executed agreements and change history.

archetype.name: Remote access control evidence
archetype.description: Evidence that remote access is controlled, monitored, and configured per policy.
archetype.collection_notes: Demonstrate MFA, least privilege, and session controls; validate by sample access events.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain configuration exports and log samples per audit period.

archetype.name: External user offboarding evidence
archetype.description: Evidence that external accounts are disabled/removed promptly when no longer needed.
acceptable_forms: External account list with last login
archetype.collection_notes: Sample expired access; verify disablement and removal from groups/roles; confirm monitoring on residual access.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain offboarding records and periodic audit results.

archetype.name: Security awareness training completion report
archetype.description: Evidence that users complete required awareness training on a defined cadence.
archetype.collection_notes: Include in-scope users, cadence, completion rates; sample late completions and corrective actions.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain completion reports per audit window.

archetype.name: Role-based training evidence
archetype.description: Evidence of additional training for privileged/technical roles.
archetype.collection_notes: Confirm privileged users receive training relevant to responsibilities and tooling; keep role roster aligned.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain curriculum and completion evidence per policy.

archetype.name: Repository access controls evidence
archetype.description: Evidence of access control and review processes for repositories in scope.
archetype.collection_notes: Ensure least privilege and protected branches; validate enforcement of PR approvals where applicable.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain permission exports and protection settings per audit window.

archetype.name: CI/CD pipeline security evidence
archetype.description: Evidence pipelines are controlled, auditable, and protected when they touch CUI or CUI-derived artifacts.
archetype.collection_notes: Confirm secrets handling, logging, and artifact access controls; validate auditability and change control.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain pipeline config and audit logs per retention policy.

archetype.name: Artifact storage access control evidence
archetype.description: Evidence build artifacts/packages are stored with appropriate access controls and retention.
archetype.collection_notes: Confirm artifacts are protected from unauthorized access and tampering; validate retention and deletion policies.
archetype.retention_notes_template: Retain ACL exports and retention configs per audit period.
